from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class PaperCitationData(BaseModel):
    """Citation relationship data for one provided paper."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="This paper's title")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper references")
    citations: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that cite this paper")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Citation relationship data for all provided papers."""
    papers: list[PaperCitationData]
